plan.question: Can exact-source, exact-config seed42 repetitions of the executable schema2 magnitude and none variants localize a reproducibility discrepancy within the observed training states, while keeping observer perturbation unresolved unless separately controlled? The original magnitude source/config yields validation AUC 0.6152795936767026 in r0017, 0.6149279138846995 on exact r0019 replay, and 0.6150716634131729 in r0022 with tracing off. In r0022, magnitude minus none AUC is -0.0000305250943143 without tracing and -0.0001705464821574 with tracing; both magnitude Logloss contrasts are adverse. Schema2 compatibility and initial equality gates pass, but there is only one traced run per intervention, and tracing-on versus tracing-off magnitude differs by -0.0001400213878431 AUC. Matching none metrics and sampled input sketches do not establish execution identity. Comparing magnitude against none measures treatment divergence, not same-source nondeterminism. Prioritize retrieving execution lineage and within-source duplicate evidence before further mechanism or architecture claims; preserve favorable, negative and failed trajectories.
missing_information: No same-source duplicate schema2 magnitude or none traces exist in the authorized receipts. A prospectively fixed two-repetition block per intervention could test sampled repeatability in a later admitted phase; these seed42 runs would not estimate independent-seed variation.

Whole-run observer nonperturbation is unverified. Initial gates and one run per tracing/intervention cell cannot identify a causal tracing effect; observer effects, intermittent execution variability, and source-specific numerical changes remain alternatives. A bounded same-state traced/untraced actual-gradient and Adam-update comparison is useful only if an authorized interface exposes it.

Optimizer moments, optimizer step state, RNG state, complete causal input identities and execution-setting lineage are absent from the five-state sketches. Do not inspect credentials or runtime internals to fill these gaps; use only explicitly exported authorized records.

Collision-prone component checksums at calls 0, 1, 512, 8192 and 14660 cannot establish full tensor equality or the exact first divergent step. Duplicate mismatches can localize only sampled components or intervals; matching sketches cannot exclude hidden or intervening divergence.

Candidate sources, raw data, selected checkpoint artifacts and per-example predictions are not exposed in this phase. Independent source/update verification, checkpoint identity comparison and user-cluster uncertainty require later authorized access, not invented inputs.

No paired seed43/44 performance results are available. Preserve the historical maximum as an observed receipt; no repeated magnitude benefit, significance, semantic mediation or novelty follows from current results or same-seed duplicates.

The previous float32/64 trace failure has a retained failed receipt, while schema2 now executes. The original failing tensor and versioned dtype-code mapping remain unavailable; this compatibility history must not be interpreted as scientific counterevidence against the model mechanism.

The registered primary-paper search for reproducibility, nondeterminism, floating-point gradients and optimizer tracing returned no matches. No additional industry card is requested because the immediate uncertainty concerns local execution attribution; external architecture results do not resolve it.

Any later execution requires refreshed phase capabilities and budget accounting, unchanged frozen data/scoring contracts, prospective equality rules and controls, and reserves for final attribution, paired repetitions and the single closed assessment. No training, source edits or withheld feedback are authorized by this retrieval plan.
